overview.title: Example plugin
overview.desc: A plugin page inside the AdminCP, shipped by @vitnode/example and served by the app that installed it.

points.shell: The sidebar, the breadcrumb and the admin session guard around this page are the AdminCP's - the route declared area: "admin" and nothing else.
points.path: The URL is the one the route spells out in full. An area chooses the frame; it never adds a prefix.
points.nav: The sidebar entry that led here is a separate declaration. A plugin page may have no entry, and an entry may point anywhere.

editor.title: Editor showcase
editor.desc: Stored editor HTML rendered with EditorContent - one of everything, so a change to the tiptap extensions or to the .tiptap styles shows up here first.

form.title: Editor in a form
form.desc: AutoFormEditor inside an AutoForm. Type / for blocks, use + for panels and tables, and press Ctrl or Cmd + Enter to save.

description.label: Description
description.desc: Steps, logs and acceptance criteria. Nothing is stored - this form only shows what the editor sends.

comment.label: Comment
comment.placeholder: Leave a note for the assignee…

success.title: Issue saved
success.desc: {words, plural, one {# word} other {# words}} in the description.

article.label: {count, plural, one {Article} other {Articles}}
article.title: Articles
article.desc: Everything the Content Engine generates, from one definition.

guide.title: Plugin routing guide
guide.desc: A nested route shipped by @vitnode/example, served by the app that installed it.

index.intro: This page and the frame around it are two routes declared in one plugin's routes.ts. Neither was copied into the application - both are lazily imported from the plugin's own build output.

points.nested: A layout claims no URL; this index page claims the layout's.
points.messages: The layout declares the messages both pages render in, so they are warmed alongside the code.
points.breadcrumb: The breadcrumb above comes from the layout, next to the component that needs it.

topic.from_index: You arrived here from the guide index - the route's search contract recognised it, and everything else in the query string was dropped.

browse.title: Browse
browse.description: A paginated list, shipped by the example plugin.

browse.title: Browse
browse.desc: A paginated page whose route declares an eager search schema, so ?page=999 is clamped before anything renders.

payments.title: Payments example
payments.desc: Buy a lifetime pass or subscribe to the Pro plan. Each unlocks a members-only certificate that the API only returns after a confirmed payment.

lifetime.title: Lifetime pass
lifetime.desc: Pay once, keep it. A full refund takes it away again; a partial refund does not.

plan.title: Pro plan
plan.desc: Billed monthly or yearly and renewed automatically. Cancel any time - you keep access until the end of the paid period.

payments.open_checkout: You already started a checkout for this. Continue it, or cancel it to start over.
payments.canceled: Checkout canceled. You have not been charged.
payments.sign_in: Sign in to buy or subscribe.
payments.test_mode: In Stripe test mode, pay with card 4242 4242 4242 4242, any future expiry date and any CVC. No real money moves.

feature.title: Supporter certificate
feature.error: The certificate could not be loaded.

disabled.title: Payments are not enabled
disabled.desc: This demo needs a payment provider. Add Stripe test keys to the API's environment and restart - the Payments documentation walks through it in a few minutes.
